title: Trucker Gets Revenge After Strip Club Kicks Him Out: Cops
description:
A North Carolina man was arrested outside a strip club in Tampa, Florida after allegedly running his semi-truck into multiple people after a heated argument, killing one. Around 5 a.m. police were called to the strip club where multiple witnesses said a suspect, later identified as Dylan Fogle, 26, was kicked out of the club with his friend before Fogle allegedly got into the semi-truck and accelerated toward a group of people killing one and leaving two others seriously injured. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
